# Cursor

> > Cursor is an AI-powered code editor with an extensible plugin marketplace for integrating development tools, testing frameworks, analytics platforms, and MCP servers.

Cursor enables developers to enhance their coding workflow through plugins that connect to services like Supabase, Sentry, BrowserStack, and more. The marketplace features both official Cursor plugins and third-party integrations supporting testing automation, error monitoring, content management, and AI-driven development workflows.

## Key Topics

- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Cursor Plugins
- AI-Powered Code Editor
- Agent Orchestration
- Cross-Browser Testing
- Error Monitoring & Debugging
- Mobile App Testing
- Database Management
- Web Scraping & Search
- Content Management Systems
- Security Scanning
- Product Analytics
- Accessibility Testing
- Test Automation
- Developer Tools Integration

## Core Cursor Plugins

- [Continual Learning](https://cursor.com/marketplace/cursor/continual-learning): Official Cursor plugin for learning user preferences via AGENTS.md

## Development & Database Tools

- [Supabase](https://cursor.com/marketplace/supabase): Supabase plugin for Postgres database management & project config
- [Sanity](https://cursor.com/marketplace/sanity): Sanity CMS plugin with GROQ queries & content modeling support
- [Webflow](https://cursor.com/marketplace/webflow): Webflow plugin for CMS management, accessibility audits & asset optimization
- [Context7](https://cursor.com/marketplace/upstash): Upstash Context7 MCP server for version-specific documentation lookup

## Testing & Quality Assurance

- [BrowserStack](https://cursor.com/marketplace/browserstack): BrowserStack plugin for cross-browser & mobile testing with Appium support
- [Snyk](https://cursor.com/marketplace/snyk): Snyk plugin for security scanning & vulnerability remediation

## Monitoring & Analytics

- [Sentry](https://cursor.com/marketplace/sentry): Sentry plugin for error monitoring, debugging & MCP integration
- [Amplitude](https://cursor.com/marketplace/amplitude): Amplitude plugin for product analytics, dashboards & A/B testing

## Data & Research Tools

- [Firecrawl](https://cursor.com/marketplace/firecrawl): Firecrawl plugin for AI-powered web scraping, crawling & search
- [Parallel](https://cursor.com/marketplace/parallel): Parallel plugin for web search, research & data enrichment via parallel-cli

## Optional Integrations

- [JFrog](https://cursor.com/marketplace/jfrog): JFrog Platform plugin for Artifactory & supply-chain security
- [Meta Reality Labs](https://cursor.com/marketplace/meta-reality-labs): Meta Quest & Horizon OS development plugin with Unity & WebXR support
- [eToro](https://cursor.com/marketplace/etoro): eToro API plugin for trading, market data & portfolio management
